name: Diun
tagline: Notifies when Docker images get updates
description: Docker Image Update Notifier — watches the images used by your stacks and alerts you through ntfy, Telegram, Discord and more when newer tags exist.
compose:
services:
  diun:
    image: crazymax/diun:latest
    command: serve --values-file /etc/diun/diun.yml
    environment:
      TZ: "${{cfg.timezone}}"
      DIUN_PROVIDERS_DOCKER: "true"
      DIUN_NOTIF_WEBHOOK_URL: "${{cfg.notify_url}}"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
